category_title: Pre-engaged students with organizational and focus challenges
scenario_title: Organizing materials for a quick read decoding activity
minimal_context: The student is seated at his desk looking for a decodable booklet to begin a quick read decoding activity.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time to start the quick read decoding activity. Please find your copy of the booklet in your desk.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Busy digging through his desk as several wrinkled booklets fall out) I'm not sure if I have the right one.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Keep looking to see if you can find it.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Puts the wrinkled booklets aside and continues digging)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just do your best to get ready.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Gets distracted and eventually stuffs all of the booklets back into his desk, missing the quick read entirely)
